jobs.description:
How does a salary of €14.99 gross per hour (excluding shift bonus), travel allowance, a pension plan, and flexible working hours sound to you? Imagine the freedom to balance your work with personal commitments, allowing you to enjoy more time with family, pursue hobbies, or simply have some extra relaxation time. On top of that, you'll have nice colleagues who work with you every day in an informal and fun way. Sounds like the perfect part-time position? Read on to find out more about the vacancy!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for part-time production employees for Yellow Chips in Emmeloord.

As a production employee at Yellow Chips you will have a varied job and you will work in a group of great colleagues. Your daily tasks will consist of: 

    - Collecting baked chips in crates and placing them on the conveyor belt
    
- Packing bags of chips
    
- Stacking boxes on pallets

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Shift bonuses of 25% to 100% on top of your hourly wage
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Reimbursement of travel costs from ten kilometers € 0.23 per kilometer
    
- Full-time job with flexible working hours
    
- Free access to e-learning platform Manpower Academy
    
- Working in a friendly team

    - Availability of at least two shifts per week
    
- Own transportation to get to the work location (car, bike, scooter)
    
- Good command of the English or Dutch language in word and writing (in connection with safety instructions)

Would you like to work here, but are looking for a full-time job? Great, because that's an option too! Click here to view the vacancy and to apply.

Do you meet all the requirements and have you become enthusiastic about the position? Do not wait any longer and apply today!
